target.title: docs: document local text worker pattern
target.body:
﻿Closes #51333

## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a docs gap where users had to infer the cloud-orchestrator plus local-text-workers pattern from separate local-model, sub-agent, CLI-backend, LLM task, timeout, and sandbox pages.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds a focused Gateway docs page for the existing pattern: keep tool use and side effects with a strong hosted orchestrator, while local models handle bounded text or JSON worker tasks. The page does not introduce new runtime behavior or config; it composes existing documented surfaces and calls out the important caveats around native sub-agents and CLI backend tool access.

## User Impact

Users can now find one practical path for mixing cloud and local models without assuming local models should autonomously use tools. The new page is linked from the Gateway Protocols and APIs navigation and includes verification, timeout, sandbox, and troubleshooting guidance.

## Evidence

Head SHA: `2c21be135103994dc9cbbd1c437723d9a7ab0ce4`

Commands run:

```text
git diff --check -- docs/docs_map.md docs/gateway/local-text-workers.md
node scripts/docs-list.js | Select-String 'local-text-workers'
pnpm docs:check-i18n-glossary --base upstream/main
node scripts/generate-docs-map.mjs --check
oxfmt --write --threads=1 --config .oxfmtrc.jsonc docs/gateway/local-text-workers.md (verification copy)
```

Observed results:

```text
gateway\local-text-workers.md - Pattern: cloud model orchestrates and uses tools; local models do bounded text-only work
Finished in 1780ms on 1 files using 1 threads.
docs:map: docs/docs_map.md is up to date.
```

`git diff --check -- docs/docs_map.md docs/gateway/local-text-workers.md` and `docs:check-i18n-glossary --base upstream/main` exited with no output and status 0.

Earlier page-level docs proof on this PR also passed:

```text
node scripts/docs-link-audit.mjs
node scripts/check-docs-mdx.mjs docs README.md
checked_internal_links=5753
broken_links=0
Docs MDX check passed (696 files, 20150ms).
```

Notes:

- Follow-up commits align the two Markdown tables in `docs/gateway/local-text-workers.md` with the docs formatter and refresh `docs/docs_map.md` for the new page.
- No runtime, config, auth, provider, security, availability, automation, message-delivery, or device path is changed.
